title: Quietly Pungent Spanish Wagyu Paella Valenciana
description: A pungent and pillowy Spanish dish featuring Wagyu beef, soffritto base, and anti-inflammatory friendly ingredients, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large paella pan or skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced Wagyu beef and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Remove the beef from the pan and set aside.
Add the chopped onions to the pan and cook until they are translucent and starting to caramelize, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the pan and cook for an additional minute.
Stir in the smoked paprika, saffron threads, and turmeric, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the uncooked Calasparra rice to the pan, stirring to combine with the spice mixture.
Add the chicken broth to the pan, bringing the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the pan, and simmer for 20 minutes, or until the rice is cooked and the liquid has been absorbed.
Return the cooked Wagyu beef to the pan, and season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
